data.body: **P2 — Prevent dynamic plugins from being loaded twice on the older-core fallback.** The copied plugin list already contains instances selected through `DURABLE_EXECUTION_PLUGINS`, but building this fresh configuration performs environment discovery again. Since older cores lack exclusive-group validation, one environment-selected OTel view is registered twice, producing duplicate spans and competing context/MDC hooks. When `toBuilder` is unavailable, either reject environment-based plugin configuration clearly or avoid passing resolved dynamic instances through a builder that will rediscover them; automate this case against the released core.
